summary.intent: Add automatic and manual refresh functionality to the leaderboard screen in a Vite/JS game project.
summary.outcome: Implemented 15-second auto-polling in the shared leaderboard panel and added a manual refresh button with loading state, accessible label, and mobile-responsive styling. Changes committed and push to main was in progress.

repo: Leaderboard logic is split across src/leaderboard.js (data/API), src/leaderboardPanel.js (shared UI panel), and src/main.js (routing/entry points).
The /leaderboard route calls showTitleLeaderboard() once on load; post-save refresh was already handled via POST response data in leaderboardPanel.js.
The project uses Vite dev server; port 5173 was occupied so dev ran on 5174.
The database API is intentionally disabled in Vite dev mode, so the leaderboard shows an unavailable state locally.
BOOTH_GUIDE.md exists as an untracked file that should not be committed.
The repo has a codex/leaderboard-route branch; origin/main had advanced but had the same tree content as the branch's prior two commits.

code.finding: showTitleLeaderboard() is called here for the title screen leaderboard entry point.
/leaderboard route calls showTitleLeaderboard() once on page load with no polling.
Post-save re-render uses updated entries from the POST response body.
Manual refresh button added here, beside the Back button in the board action row.
Refresh button styles added here, including mobile sizing rules.

workflow: The entire CLI tool (entire status, entire explain --checkpoint) is used in this repo for recording and querying implementation intent/checkpoints.
The building-components skill provides guidance on accessible interactive controls including focus and loading states.
Polling was scoped to the panel's visible/board state to avoid background intervals leaking after panel close.
Git rebase onto origin/main was chosen over a direct push because origin/main had advanced; the branch history was verified to be equivalent before rebasing.
Only specific files (src/leaderboardPanel.js, src/style.css) were staged to intentionally exclude BOOTH_GUIDE.md.

friction: Vite dev port 5173 was already in use, requiring the dev server to fall back to port 5174.
origin/main had advanced since the branch was created, requiring a rebase before push could succeed — a straight push would have been rejected.
The git commit command was still running through repository hooks at the end of the session, requiring a wait.
The leaderboard API being disabled in dev mode limited browser verification to DOM/control presence checks rather than full data flow testing.
open_items: The git push to main was not confirmed complete — the commit was still running through hooks at end of session.
The 15-second polling interval was chosen without explicit discussion; may want to revisit if it causes unnecessary API load.
No tests were written for the new auto-refresh or manual refresh button behavior — existing tests passed but new behavior is untested.
